protocol_name: Cognix Perception and Tracking Pre-Registered Evaluation Protocol (Audit Revision 1.1)

m9_baseline_immutable_queue.purpose: Immutable benchmark baseline preserved for regression comparison

m9_normal_control_queue.purpose: Normal control evaluation queue for false alarm quantification (Town01)

qualification_backup_reference.qualification_state: Runtime V1 qualified (596 candidate checks, 21 component checks, NO_REAL_DATA_ACCESS)

bipartite_matching.algorithm: Priority 1: continuity match from immediately preceding evaluated frame if IoU >= 0.50 and class matches. Priority 2: greedy bipartite matching by descending IoU.
bipartite_matching.class_constraint: Exact taxonomy match required (COCO detector category -> Evaluation taxonomy).
bipartite_matching.mismatch_rule: IoU >= 0.50 with mismatched taxonomy class is strictly rejected as a match. Counted as False Positive for the predicted class and False Negative for the true GT class.

ignore_region_semantics.rule: Unmatched predictions overlapping an ignore_ambiguous box with IoU >= 0.50 are absorbed as ignored_matches with 0 FP penalty. Background false alarms on clear roadway or sky do not overlap ignore boxes and strictly increment FP.

detection_metrics.true_positive_tp: Number of successfully matched (GT, prediction) pairs satisfying class agreement and IoU >= 0.50.
detection_metrics.false_negative_fn: Active ground truth objects without a matching prediction: FN = num_gt - TP.
detection_metrics.target_false_positive_fp: Target-class predictions not matched to any active GT and not absorbed by an ignore_ambiguous region (ghost hazards).
detection_metrics.out_of_scope_detections: Predictions belonging to out-of-scope COCO categories (e.g. traffic light, bench). Segregated from target FP, strictly rejected from matching targets, and reported transparently.
detection_metrics.ignored_prediction: Predictions not matched to active GT but absorbed by an ignore_ambiguous region.
detection_metrics.target_recall: TP / (TP + FN) = TP / num_gt if num_gt > 0 else 0.0
detection_metrics.target_f1_score: 2 * Precision * Recall / (Precision + Recall) if (Precision + Recall) > 0 else 0.0
detection_metrics.all_detections_precision: TP / (TP + FP_target + out_of_scope_detections) if denominator > 0 else 0.0
detection_metrics.reviewed_empty_frame_handling: When num_gt == 0, if FP == 0, clean performance (0 FP); if FP > 0, precision = 0.0.

mota_components.total_gt_detections: Total ground-truth target object instances across all evaluated frames.
mota_components.total_fn_detections: Total missed ground-truth target instances across all evaluated frames.
mota_components.total_fp_detections: Total target-class false positive detections across all evaluated frames (excluding ignore regions).
mota_components.identity_switches: Total number of times a tracked GT object's associated predicted track identity changes across frames.

tracking_metrics.zero_gt_handling_policy: If total_gt_detections == 0 and total_fp_detections == 0: MOTA = 1.0 (clean silent tracking on empty sequences). If total_gt_detections == 0 and total_fp_detections > 0: MOTA = 0.0 (penalized for false alarms; avoids undefined division by zero).
tracking_metrics.fragmentation_frag: Count of transitions where an active GT object was tracked at evaluated frame k-1 and missed at evaluated frame k while still present in the sequence.
tracking_metrics.mostly_tracked_mt: GT tracks detected for >= 80% of their ground truth lifespan.
tracking_metrics.partially_tracked_pt: GT tracks detected for 20% to 80% of their ground truth lifespan.
tracking_metrics.mostly_lost_ml: GT tracks detected for < 20% of their ground truth lifespan.

frame_states.UNREVIEWED: Frame has not undergone human review (reviewer_id is null or unconfirmed drafts exist).
frame_states.CONFIRMED_WITH_OBJECTS: Frame has been human-audited; all contained objects are confirmed by reviewer.
frame_states.CONFIRMED_EMPTY: Frame has been human-audited and confirmed to contain zero traffic targets or ignore regions.
frame_states.REQUIRES_ADJUDICATION: Frame contains inter-annotator conflict, unresolved ambiguity, or supervisor escalation flag.

gating_rules.default_behavior: Strict refusal: IncompleteAnnotationError is raised if any frame in dataset is UNREVIEWED or REQUIRES_ADJUDICATION.
gating_rules.exploratory_bypass: Requires explicit exploratory=True (CLI flag --exploratory); outputs are watermarked with provisional research disclaimers.
